clue.text: Endearingly pretty hair style, the last thing in coiffure

parts.note: a cut is a style of haircut

indicators.note: the final letter of the word coiffure is wanted

explanation.surface: A sweet little hairdo, finished off at the salon.
explanation.definitionFit: Something cute is attractive in an endearing, appealing way; the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Church painter is a parliamentary reformer

parts.note: a painter is an artist

explanation.surface: A church artist who also campaigned for political reform.
explanation.walkthrough: The Chartists were a 19th-century British movement demanding reform of Parliament, such as votes for all men.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the Chartist movement pressed for parliamentary reform in Victorian Britain.

clue.text: Seek to attract short-term worker with little time

parts.note: a temp is a temporary worker
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: An employer trying to lure a temporary worker with very little time on offer.
explanation.definitionFit: To tempt someone is to entice or try to draw them in.

clue.text: Killer of two fools at home

indicators.note: two fools means the word for a fool is written twice

parts.note: an ass is a fool
in means at home

explanation.surface: A murderer descended from a pair of idiots who stayed in.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassin is a murderer, especially one who kills a public figure.

clue.text: Running Ascot they sure keep on to the very end

definitions.text: keep on to the very end

indicators.note: running suggests the letters of the racecourse phrase are set in motion and rearranged

explanation.surface: Horses running at Ascot races that are sure to finish the race.
explanation.walkthrough: Ascot is an English racecourse, fitting the racing surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to persevere until finished, from a horse completing the whole race.

clue.text: Moving play about trollop's end has to be relevant

indicators.note: about places the rearranged play around the single letter
moving shows the letters of play are shifted into a new order
the end of trollop is its final letter

explanation.surface: A theatre production about a loose woman having to be topical.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Moving' rearranges PLAY to APLY; 'about' puts it round P, the end of 'trollop'.
explanation.definitionFit: When a rule applies it is relevant or pertinent to the case.

clue.text: Take up something most essential, as for citrus fruit

indicators.note: in a down answer, take up means read the letters upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a must is something absolutely essential
taken as written

explanation.surface: Choose something vital, such as a piece of fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take up' reverses A MUST and AS together to give SATSUMA.
explanation.definitionFit: A satsuma is a kind of mandarin orange, a citrus fruit.

clue.text: North-east contains one large river

indicators.note: contains means the compass point letters hold the others between them

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A region in the north-east has one big river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nile is the great river of Egypt and north-east Africa.

clue.text: Thin plate served up for lamb, perhaps

indicators.note: in a down answer, served up means the letters rise, read in reverse

parts.note: a lamina is a thin layer or plate

explanation.surface: Lamb dished up on a thin plate.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is a dinner; 'lamb' is not meat here but a living creature.
explanation.definitionFit: A lamb is an example of a creature, so 'perhaps' marks it as one instance of the category.

clue.text: Song about chaps in Caucasian republic

indicators.note: about means the song wraps around the chaps

parts.note: an aria is a song from an opera
chaps are men

explanation.surface: An opera song about some fellows living in a Caucasus country.
explanation.definitionFit: Armenia is a country in the Caucasus region between Europe and Asia.

clue.text: What's seen in peony's head and others?

definitions.text: What's seen in peony's head and others?

indicators.note: the head of peony is its first letter

parts.note: et al is Latin shorthand for and others

explanation.surface: A question about what a flower head and similar blooms show.
explanation.walkthrough: Whole clue is both wordplay and definition: a flower's head is made of these.
explanation.definitionFit: The head of a peony and of other flowers is made up of these coloured leaf-like parts.

clue.text: Something sacred to the vacant millions

indicators.note: vacant means the middle of the word the is emptied, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: Something holy to the empty-headed masses.
explanation.definitionFit: A totem is an emblem or object revered as sacred by a group.

clue.text: Experiment with fish stuffed with thyme in the middle

indicators.note: stuffed with means the fish has a letter put inside it

parts.note: a trout is a fish

indicators.note: the middle letter of thyme is wanted

explanation.surface: A cook experimenting with fish filled with thyme stuffing.
explanation.definitionFit: A tryout is a test or trial run, an experiment.

clue.text: Hotel guest is torn about team

indicators.note: about means the torn word goes around the team

parts.note: rent is an old past participle of rend, meaning torn
a side is a team

explanation.surface: A hotel guest is upset about a sports team.
explanation.definitionFit: A resident in a hotel is someone staying there, a guest.

clue.text: Take responsibility for knife in part of the body

parts.note: to shoulder something is to take on the burden of it
a blade is a knife

explanation.surface: Accepting the blame for a knife in someone's body.
explanation.definitionFit: The scapula, a flat bone at the back, is part of the human body.

clue.text: Rejected openly gay group of actors

parts.note: out describes someone openly gay
a cast is the group of actors in a show

explanation.surface: An openly gay group of actors who were turned down.
explanation.definitionFit: An outcast is someone cast aside or shunned by society.

clue.text: Cook is required in Scottish bank

indicators.note: required in means the word is goes inside the bank

parts.note: brae is a Scottish word for a hillside or bank

explanation.surface: A chef is needed at a Scottish bank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bank' suggests a building society, but here it is a slope.
explanation.definitionFit: To braise is to cook slowly in a covered pot with a little liquid.

clue.text: Boss takes one round film production company

parts.note: a stud is a boss, a raised ornamental knob
I is the Roman numeral for one
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: The head of a film company takes someone out for a round.
explanation.definitionFit: A studio is a firm that makes films, as in a Hollywood studio.

clue.text: Bad spirit of public protest over conclusion of coalition

indicators.note: in a down answer, over means the protest sits above the final letter

parts.note: a demo is a demonstration, a public protest

indicators.note: the last letter of coalition is wanted

explanation.surface: The angry mood of a protest at the end of a coalition government.
explanation.definitionFit: A demon is an evil spirit or devil.

clue.text: Piece of evidence needs a liberal interpretation at first

indicators.note: at first means only the first letter of interpretation is used

explanation.surface: Evidence that requires a generous reading from the start.
explanation.definitionFit: An alibi is evidence that the accused was elsewhere when the crime happened.

clue.text: Book list is mind-expanding to some extent

indicators.note: to some extent means only a portion of the letters of mind-expanding is taken

explanation.surface: A reading list is partly mind-broadening.
explanation.definitionFit: An index is the alphabetical list of topics at the back of a book.

clue.text: Pain is hard in top performer

indicators.note: in places the hard letter inside the top performer

parts.note: an ace is an expert, a star performer
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: Suffering is hard for a star.
explanation.definitionFit: An ache is a dull, continuous pain.

clue.text: Clubs have an adverse effect on pulling power

parts.note: C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs
to harm is to damage or affect badly

explanation.surface: Nightclubs damage one's ability to attract a partner.
explanation.definitionFit: Charm is the power to attract or delight people, an appeal.

clue.text: Remainder live outside centre of Truro

indicators.note: outside means the living word wraps round the central letter

parts.note: to reside is to live somewhere

indicators.note: the middle letter of Truro is wanted

explanation.surface: Those left over live outside the middle of Truro.
explanation.walkthrough: Truro is a city in Cornwall, England.
explanation.definitionFit: A residue is what is left over, the remaining part.

clue.text: Offered a redrafting of deed next

indicators.note: a redrafting means the letters of deed next are written out again in a new order

explanation.surface: A revised version of the next deed was put forward.
explanation.definitionFit: To extend an offer is to give it, so extended means offered, as in extended a welcome.

clue.text: Death of former partner with sex appeal

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
it is old slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: The demise of a sexy ex-lover.
explanation.definitionFit: An exit can mean a departure from life, a euphemism for dying.
